# Tonalo

> Tonalo is a free, open source music player for your own Navidrome or Subsonic server. It runs on LG TVs (webOS 5 and newer), Windows, Mac, iPhone (iOS 17 and newer) and Apple Watch, with CarPlay. No ads, no in-app purchases, no tracking. You need your own Navidrome or Subsonic server.

## Pages
- [Home](https://tonalo.app/): overview, in-browser demo with example songs, downloads, FAQ
- [Deutsch](https://tonalo.app/de/): the same page in German
- [Changelog](https://tonalo.app/changelog.html): what changed in each version

## Facts
- Price: free, MIT license, source code on GitHub: https://github.com/Wzkiie/tonalo
- iPhone: App Store (https://apps.apple.com/app/id6827727370); also Apple Watch app and CarPlay
- Jukebox: friends join with a 6-digit code, also works in the car without Wi-Fi
- Audiobooks and podcasts from Audiobookshelf in the same app
- Android is not available
